parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the secure tunnel. The description can be up to 1024 characters in length.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the specified device.
><notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID of the specified device.

><notice>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If the ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the specified device belongs.

><notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: Udi
parameters.description:
The custom information to be pushed to the device. The data format is user-defined and can be up to 4096 characters in length.

This information is sent to the device when the device is notified of the secure tunnel creation.
